2608.05107.title: CoPlan: A Trustworthy Co-Intelligence Interface for Care Planning through Role-Based Contestable Argument Graphs
2608.05107.paper_summary: AI-supported care planning can help clinicians, patients, caregivers, and care teams coordinate complex decisions across clinical, functional, psychosocial, and environmental needs. However, many AI systems present recommendations as fixed outputs, limiting stakeholders' ability to inspect, challenge, and revise plans when they conflict with clinical judgment, patient values, or real-world feasibility. We present CoPlan - a Co-Intelligent and Contestable Interface for Human-AI Care Planning. CoPlan uses a multi-agent workflow in which specialized AI agents generate candidate interventions and supporting or challenging arguments, while human care planners can accept, reject, modify, or add arguments before final plan generation. Through this design, CoPlan combines co-intelligence, in which humans and AI agents contribute complementary expertise, with contestability, where recommendations remain open to inspection, revision, and justification. We demonstrate CoPlan in an aging-in-place care planning scenario. The system supports adaptive care team recruitment, role-based argument review, final care plan generation, and practical follow-up through scheduling agents. This work contributes a contestable care planning interface and a design framing for trustworthy human-AI care planning that preserves human agency and clinical accountability.
2608.05107.paper_summary_zh: AI 支援的照護規劃可以幫助臨床醫生、病人、照護者和照護團隊協調在臨床、功能、心理社會和環境需求方面的複雜決策。<lb/>然而，許多 AI 系統將建議呈現為固定的輸出，限制了利益相關者在與臨床判斷、病人價值觀或現實可行性衝突時檢查、挑戰和修訂計劃的能力。<lb/>我們提出了 CoPlan - 一個人類與 AI 照護規劃的共同智能和可爭議介面。<lb/>CoPlan 使用多代理工作流程，其中專門的 AI 代理生成候選干預措施及支持或挑戰的論點，而人類照護規劃者可以在最終計劃生成之前接受、拒絕、修改或添加論點。<lb/>通過這種設計，CoPlan 結合了共同智能，其中人類和 AI 代理貢獻互補的專業知識，以及可爭議性，推薦保持開放以供檢查、修訂和辯護。<lb/>我們在一個居家老化照護規劃情境中展示了 CoPlan。<lb/>該系統支持自適應的照護團隊招募、基於角色的論點審查、最終照護計劃生成，以及通過排程代理進行的實際後續行動。<lb/>這項工作貢獻了一個可爭議的照護規劃介面和一個設計框架，以實現可靠的人類與 AI 照護規劃，保護人類的主體性和臨床責任。
